entradas.text: I came to the Grand National Assembly of Sordland to deliver a speech regarding the new Constitution and ask for the support of the Assembly before the upcoming vote.
I walked quickly through the corridors, giving my greetings to people on my way towards the parliamentary hall.
When I entered the hall, the Assembly was in complete chaos, with shouting and cursing between the parties. There was a heavy argument about a proposal made by an MP from NFP.
"We both know that our Constitution is flawed."
entradas.menu: "We both know that our Constitution is flawed."

entradas.text: I took my seat inside the special area reserved for the ministers. Gloria was shouting from her seat at the centre of the hall as she hit the gavel three times, with each strike heavier than the one before.
<shout>"ORDER! ORDER!"</shout>
"We must finally rewrite the Constitution of Soll and break our chains of the past!"
entradas.menu: "We must finally rewrite the Constitution of Soll and break our chains of the past!"

entradas.text: Despite her efforts, the argument continued for a couple of minutes before everybody took back to their seats and finally went quiet.
"Mr. Kibener, next time when I tell you to do so, either take your seat or leave the hall; so we can proceed with the procedures of this Assembly and continue our duties."
He murmured something from his seat which was illegible from my position.
Some MP's from the NFP side shouted back at her in protest.
"We are not specifically cooperating with someone, but everyone. We ask that you also join us."
entradas.menu: "We are not specifically cooperating with someone, but everyone. We ask that you also join us."

entradas.text: "Honorable ladies and gentlemen, if you allow me to continue..."
I looked at him.
"We have the President here with us today. He has asked to give an important announcement."
I saw Kesaro Kibener standing up from his seat and shouting towards the members of the PFJP.
"I'm saddened to hear about your opposite stance."
entradas.menu: "I'm saddened to hear about your opposite stance."

entradas.text: "Mr. Kibener! Calm yourself! Show respect to the procedures of this Assembly!"
"I respect your opinion."
entradas.menu: "I respect your opinion."

entradas.text: She pointed at me.
"Thank you, Mrs. Speaker."
entradas.menu: "Thank you, Mrs. Speaker."

entradas.text: "Do not stand against change! Be a part of it, Mr. Ricter! We can do much more together."
entradas.menu: "Do not stand against change! Be a part of it, Mr. Ricter! We can do much more together."

entradas.text: "You have the floor, Mr. President."
The Assembly fell silent.
"We don't need you."
entradas.menu: "We don't need you."

entradas.text: I walked to the stand as loud clapping started in the USP's side.
"Don't you dare stand against us! Otherwise, know that the PFJP is guaranteed to be history."
entradas.menu: "Don't you dare stand against us! Otherwise, know that the PFJP is guaranteed to be history."

entradas.text: "Ladies and Gentlemen of the Grand National Assembly of Sordland! I am here today to raise important questions regarding our outdated Constitution."
entradas.menu: "Ladies and Gentlemen..."

entradas.text: "It is you, who shouldn't use the word 'democratic' when you want your way to succeed but disregard our opinion."
entradas.menu: "It is you, who shouldn't use the word 'democratic' when you want your way to succeed but disregard our opinion."

entradas.text: "The Supreme Court holds too much power over our elected branches! They have been obstructing the law making process and has long plagued the democracy in Sordland. Tarquin Soll gave this power to the Court for the sole reason to protect the Constitution of the 20's, which leads us to fail in adapting to the new world..."
entradas.menu: "The Supreme Court holds too much power..."

entradas.text: "Our election threshold has harmed our democracy more than anything since the formation of our republic. As USP, we have governed for a long time and I can acknowledge that this success was partly the result of our current 10% percent threshold."
entradas.menu: "Our election threshold has harmed our democracy more than anything..."

entradas.text: "It is time to strengthen the executive to enact faster and more powerful reforms!"
entradas.menu: "It is time to strengthen the executive to enact faster and more powerful reforms!"

entradas.text: I continued.
"...Therefore, we propose changes to the Constitution to prepare Sordland for a fast changing new world!"
entradas.menu: "...Therefore, we propose changes to the Constitution to prepare Sordland for a fast changing new world!"

entradas.text: "We will break the Supreme Court's authority over constitutional changes."
entradas.menu: "We will break the Supreme Court's authority over constitutional changes."

entradas.text: "I will break down the obstacles before me!"
entradas.menu: "I will break down the obstacles before me!"

entradas.text: "We will rebalance the branches of government to ensure a more democratic process."
entradas.menu: "We will rebalance the branches of government to ensure a more democratic process."

entradas.text: "It is more important than ever that we stand united as a nation in these changing times. I call everybody to be part of the change our people has been calling for. We all want to make Sordland better, don't we? Let's embrace democracy and unite under the banner of our people, and surely Sordland will be great again!"
entradas.menu: Unity.

entradas.text: Loud noises came from USP and NFP seats.
"Mr. President, with all due respect, I believe Sordland already has a functioning Constitution."
"Please don't interrupt me."
entradas.menu: "Please don't interrupt me."

entradas.text: "I'm not finished yet, Mrs. Tory."
entradas.menu: "I'm not finished yet, Mrs. Tory."

entradas.text: "Ladies and gentlemen of the Assembly! We must set aside our differences."
entradas.menu: "Ladies and gentlemen of the Assembly! We must set aside our differences."

entradas.text: I took a breath and continued.
"It is time to make a new Constitution together!"
entradas.menu: "It is time to make a new Constitution together!"

entradas.text: "I ask everyone to think clearly about our current situation. And join us for change."
entradas.menu: "I ask everyone to think clearly about our current situation. And join us for change."

entradas.text: Gloria looked at me to see if I'd finished my response.
"Ladies and Gentlemen, I demand your votes!"
entradas.menu: "Ladies and Gentlemen, I demand your votes!"

entradas.text: "Let's write the future together!"
entradas.menu: "Let's write the future together!"

entradas.text: "I ask everyone to support us in the upcoming vote."
entradas.menu: "I ask everyone to support us in the upcoming vote."

entradas.text: "Be part of a new era for Sordland. Join us and vote for our proposal."
entradas.menu: "Be part of a new era for Sordland. Join us and vote for our proposal."

entradas.text: "I will address all the problems of the past in my proposal!"
entradas.menu: "I will address all the problems of the past in my proposal!"

entradas.text: "USP will change and lead Sordland into the future!"
entradas.menu: "USP will change and lead Sordland into the future!"

entradas.text: "For justice in Sordland!"
entradas.menu: "For justice in Sordland!"

entradas.text: Gloria looked at me to see if I'd finished my response.
"For a strong Sordland!"
entradas.menu: "For a strong Sordland!"

entradas.text: "For a united Sordland!"
entradas.menu: "For a united Sordland!"

entradas.text: "We will bring change regardless of your support."
entradas.menu: "We will bring change regardless of your support."

entradas.text: "For a free Sordland!"
entradas.menu: "For a free Sordland!"

entradas.text: "Your times have passed, Mr. Ricter."
entradas.menu: "Your times have passed, Mr. Ricter."

entradas.text: The Assembly roared with all kinds of different reactions.
"Thank you."
entradas.menu: "Thank you."

entradas.text: "Thank you, Mrs. Speaker."
"Thank you for the speech, Mr. President."
"Honorable Members of the Grand National Assembly of Sordland! I am here today to raise important questions regarding our outdated Constitution."
entradas.menu: "Honorable Members of Assembly..."

entradas.text: "I expect your support in the upcoming vote, Mr. Ricter."
entradas.menu: "I expect your support in the upcoming vote, Mr. Ricter."

entradas.text: "Brothers and sisters! I am here today to raise important questions regarding our outdated Constitution."
entradas.menu: "Brothers and sisters..."

entradas.text: "We will stand together with any attempt to protect and strengthen our established political culture and national values. Thank you."
"Thank you, Mrs. Speaker."
MP's kept shouting and responding to each other, creating a loud mess where nothing was legible.

"Our Constitution doesn't adequately define or respect the separation of powers and the balance between the branches. In order to strengthen our democracy, we must be brave enough to point out the faults of our Constitution."
entradas.menu: "Our Constitution doesn't adequately define or respect the separation of powers..."

entradas.text: "Order! Order! This topic has finished. We are moving unto our next topic..."

"We have always been overshadowed by the Old Guard and the judiciary branch in Sordland. The Grand National Assembly and the President must be able to exercise their job properly and without obstruction. However, our current Constitution fails to guarantee this."
entradas.menu: "We have always been overshadowed by the Old Guard..."

entradas.text: "I ask Mr. President to reevaluate his decision and not ignore the demands of our people! Otherwise you should never use the word 'democratic' again!"
I slowly left the hall. The shouting could be heard from every corridor of the Grand National Assembly.
"I call everyone to stand by us to make historic changes to our Constitution and bring it to the standards of today's world!"
entradas.menu: "I call everyone to stand by us to make historic changes to our Constitution and bring it to the standards of today's world!"

entradas.text: "As long as Mr. President continues to follow the footsteps of his party's founder, we will be doing our best to stop this proposal. We do not welcome this attempt to break our system further."
I looked at him.
I got up from my seat and started my walk towards the exit.
"I just wanted to thank everybody for their comments."
entradas.menu: "I just wanted to thank everybody for their comments."

entradas.text: I focused on...
"However, our demands seemed to be ignored by the government. Even though we made the reform committee's work possible, it was us, who were pushed back from the process."
"Mr. Ricter..."
entradas.menu: "Mr. Ricter..."

entradas.text: "We must not be afraid of change. The world is changing, and Sordland needs the change it has earned after years of Sollism in the last decades. We will rewrite the old and make a constitution that would reflect the will of the people, and open the way for a democratic Sordland!"
entradas.menu: Change.

entradas.text: "The '29 Constitution was the product of a time of war. Now is a time for peace. As we must make peace between each other, we must strive for peace in the world. We need a more democratic constitution that would reflect the will of the people, and flourish in the upcoming times of peace and prosper!"
entradas.menu: Peace.

entradas.text: "Mr. Kibener..."
entradas.menu: "Mr. Kibener..."

entradas.text: "I would like to thank Mr. President for his speech. We, the People's Freedom and Justice Party, stands in agreement with the need for a new Constitution."
"Yes, Mr. President."
Just as I was about to continue speaking, Gloria Tory interrupted me.
I got up from my seat and started my walk towards the exit.
<shout>"You and PFJP are nothing but puppets of western interests!"</shout>
I walked back to my seat as many MP's asked to speak. Frens Ricter was among them.
Suddenly Kesaro Kibener started yelling from his seat.
"Yes, Mr. Ricter."
I asked to speak.
entradas.menu: Ask to speak.

entradas.text: I decided to leave the Assembly and its chaos behind.
entradas.menu: Leave the Assembly.

entradas.text: Kesaro went back to his seat but the chaos in the Assembly continued.
"Mr. President!"
"Tarquin Soll will answer for the crimes committed during his rule! We will make sure of that!"
entradas.menu: "Tarquin Soll will answer for the crimes committed during his rule! We will make sure of that!"

entradas.text: Gloria gave him a stare. She looked annoyed.
"We will be strengthening the presidential decrees."
entradas.menu: "We will be strengthening the presidential decrees."

entradas.text: He looked directly at me.
"We will make Sordland great again!"
entradas.menu: "We will make Sordland great again!"

entradas.text: "Let's embrace the future."
entradas.menu: "Let's embrace the future."

entradas.text: Some applauses came from the NFP and USP seats. Most of the others started to make loud noises again.

"Let it be known that the NFP will do its best to aid with the draft of the new constitution, and to reach an agreement with the USP. If our concerns are listened to, NFP has the power to make this proposal pass."
<shout>"You must have lost your mind to claim you were the reason for the reform talks, Mr. Ricter!"</shout>
"The nationalist movement wants to thank Mr. Rayne for his priorities. The National Front Party will not stand in your way."
"You don't believe that."
entradas.menu: "You don't believe that."

entradas.text: The whole United Sordland Party stood up and started applauding.
"Tarquin Soll and his efforts cannot be ignored. We must keep following the path he defined for Sordish people."
"We are not here to destroy Sollism nor our cultural values."
entradas.menu: "We are not here to destroy Sollism nor our cultural values."

entradas.text: I slowly left the hall. The shouting could be heard from every corridor of the Grand National Assembly.
"...Very well, Mr. Kibener... Go ahead."
"I'm sure the Honorable Members of USP will see that the President is acting rash by allying with the opposition to destroy the culture of Sollism that established Sordland."
"Alright, Mr. President."
"That was the extent of my quick note. Thank you. The President has the floor."
"I demand to speak!"
"That was disrespectful Mrs. Speaker. Please don't try to sabotage my speech."
entradas.menu: "That was disrespectful Mrs. Speaker. Please don't try to sabotage my speech."

entradas.text: <shout>"ORDER!"</shout>
"Who are you trying to provoke, Mrs. Tory? USP is behind me."
entradas.menu: "Who are you trying to provoke, Mrs. Tory? USP is behind me."

entradas.text: "I'll act as if that didn't happen."
entradas.menu: "I'll act as if that didn't happen."

entradas.text: "Please continue your speech, Mr. President."

"It is a time of conflict and war. The superpowers of the world are in a race to control the world. Terrorists and rebels around our borders continue to operate. We must be ready for what this new world will throw at us. We must be vigilant! More importantly, Rumburg is threatening our country more than ever. We need a stronger constitution that would strengthen our nation and prepare it for the upcoming times of conflict. And we will prevail!"
entradas.menu: War.

entradas.text: "Give me the power to make Sordland great again!"
entradas.menu: "Give me the power to make Sordland great again!"

entradas.text: I saluted the crowd.
entradas.menu: Salute the crowd.

entradas.text: I decided to read a poem before I ended my speech.
entradas.menu: Finish with a poem.

entradas.text: "There is a destiny above destiny..."
entradas.menu: "There is a destiny above destiny..."

entradas.text: "There is a victory growing with every morning..."
entradas.menu: "There is a victory growing with every morning..."

entradas.text: "There is my country, beyond my existence or nonexistence..."
entradas.menu: "There is my country, beyond my existence or nonexistence..."

entradas.text: "There is a revolution, beyond our and their existence..."
entradas.menu: "There is a revolution, beyond our and their existence..."

entradas.text: "There is God, beyond existence and nonexistence..."
entradas.menu: "There is God, beyond existence and nonexistence..."

entradas.text: "There is the evil that tortures and tears me down..."
entradas.menu: "There is the evil that tortures and tears me down..."

entradas.text: "There are songs to be sung in affectation of our battles..."
entradas.menu: "There are songs to be sung in affectation of our battles..."

entradas.text: "There is a spring that blossoms out of the graves of our fallen..."
entradas.menu: "There is a spring that blossoms out of the graves of our fallen..."

entradas.text: "Do not doubt the One! There is a decision coming from the heavens..."
entradas.menu: "Do not doubt the One! There is a decision coming from the heavens..."

entradas.text: "Fear not when the dark falls! There is an artist painting the sun."
entradas.menu: "Fear not when the dark falls! There is an artist painting the sun."

entradas.text: "Do not dare call it defeat! There is a fortress made from my ashes."
entradas.menu: "Do not dare call it defeat! There is a fortress made from my ashes."

entradas.text: "Beyond the next morning, there is a victory waiting to be won."
entradas.menu: "Beyond the next morning, there is a victory waiting to be won."

entradas.text: "Rest assured, your concerns will be addressed."
entradas.menu: "Rest assured, your concerns will be addressed."

entradas.text: "We'd like to have cooperation between our parties."
entradas.menu: "We'd like to have cooperation between our parties."

entradas.text: "I welcome your positive attitude."
entradas.menu: "I welcome your positive attitude."

entradas.text: "Thank you for your support. We are looking forward to work with the NFP."
entradas.menu: "Thank you for your support. We are looking forward to work with the NFP."

entradas.text: "Thank you for the nice words."
entradas.menu: "Thank you for the nice words."

entradas.text: "I expect your support, Mr. Kibener! We can do much more together."
entradas.menu: "I expect your support, Mr. Kibener! We can do much more together."

entradas.text: "You've just promised to try Soll, Mr. President! You are talking about the founder of this party. He is the true founder of this republic."
"What crimes are you talking about? You owe everything you have to him. This is unacceptable!"
Loud noises came from USP and NFP seats.
"Hear me out."
entradas.menu: "Hear me out."

entradas.text: "Everyone! Please! Let me finish."
entradas.menu: "Everyone! Please! Let me finish."

entradas.text: "Let me explain."
entradas.menu: "Let me explain."

entradas.text: The whole United Sordland Party stood up and started shouting at me.
"Your time is over. Please sit down, Mr. President."

"Despite Mr. President here claiming to serve justice by going against his party's founder, we know this to be some hogwash! Know that we will be doing our best to stop this proposal. We do not welcome this attempt to break our system further."
